author: St. Thomas More
name: The Life of John Picus, Earl of Mirandula
name_pt: A Vida de João Pico, Conde da Mírandola
desc: More's English version (c. 1510) of the life of Giovanni Pico della Mirandola by his nephew Gianfrancesco Pico, with Pico's letters, twelve rules, twelve weapons and a prayer, and More's own verses.
desc_pt: A versão inglesa de More (c. 1510) da vida de Giovanni Pico della Mirandola por seu sobrinho Gianfrancesco Pico, com cartas, doze regras e doze armas e uma oração de Pico, e versos de More.
editor: Thomas More, tr. (London: Wynkyn de Worde, 1525)
edition: Here is co[n]teyned the lyfe of Iohan Picus erle of Myrandula (London: 1525), EEBO-TCP A09627.
